title: Repeated-grip trial gain did not improve HbA1c prediction beyond peak strength across two NHANES samples
abstract: Adding bilateral mean third-minus-first grip change to peak-grip and conventional covariate models did not establish incremental HbA1c prediction from NHANES2011–2012 (n=4149) to separately sampled2013–2014 (n=4645). Weighted baseline-minus-augmented MSE was -0.0003173 percentage-point² (400 source+target PSU-refit95%interval -0.0037983 to 0.0010615). This is a model-specific negative result,not equivalence,not evidence of clinical screening utility.
